task_draw.hex_seed_result: rejected: argument --seed: invalid int value (type=int); already reported in the open seed-format handoff from PR #5, not re-filed here
task_draw.drawn_card: replication: Produce one verified exact-count handoff

scope_change: The person running the session set focus 'explore' (prioritize a genuinely new approach, priced against a favorable best case first). The drawn replication card's deliverable (candidate.json + handoff.json passing tools/verify_count.py, equal counts acceptable) is kept, but the candidate is a new count method rather than an unchanged rank2a/persisted8 replay. The positive-control replay of the card's first experiment (seed 419) is kept separately under positive-control/.

candidate.name: sv8 (singleton locate-and-verify on top of persisted8)
candidate.idea: Run persisted8 backward search unchanged. When the suffix interval has been a single row for d consecutive checks and more than s/2+1 pattern symbols remain, locate that row with a text-position-sampled suffix array (at most s-1 LF calls via rld_rank1a) and compare the remaining prefix directly against stored text in the same multi-string BWT coordinate space (separators and N stored as exceptions). Count is then 1 or 0.
candidate.status_of_technique: Known components (FM-index backward search, text-position SA sampling for locate, plain-text verification). New to this project's records; measured here, not claimed as a new algorithm.

baselines: rank2a_AA (second independent rank2a load, A/A control)
objective: warm seconds/query (native count_batch, reps=10, randomized method order), reported with index bytes, construction time and load time separately
error_constraint: zero count mismatches against persisted8 and against the separate direct witness checker tools/verify_count.py
selection_rule: Among the 4 grid configs, pick the fastest median whole-panel warm time on development, excluding any config whose median paired ratio versus persisted8 regresses by more than 5% on any development group (length x present/absent).

evaluation.generator: src/trial.py queries(seqs, seed, n=96) as in tools/contribute.py (102 queries) for the certificate; n=960 with the same seed for per-group timing
evaluation.exposure_note: Fresh generated queries on an already exposed corpus: within-corpus evaluation, not an independent holdout.

pass_threshold: selected config >= 1.3x faster than persisted8 on the median warm time of the 102-query evaluation panel, zero mismatches, and no evaluation group regressed by more than 5% in median paired ratio
correctness_controls: agreement with persisted8 on every development and evaluation query

locate-path stress on the 10-contig repetitive panel (contains literal N runs and contig boundaries): present substrings at string starts/ends on both strands, one-mismatch-in-prefix variants, N-containing queries, boundary-crossing queries
resource_limits: shared desktop under the owner's capped launcher (one job slot, 2 cores, 12 GiB); load average about 5.4 at start, so timings are shared-machine measurements
stopping_rule: One bounded pivot if the best-case model is not reproduced. Stop new work at 11:52 UTC (75% of a 240-minute budget) and report whatever state is reached, including a failed threshold.
compiler: host gcc 16.2.1, -O3 -fPIC -shared, no fast-math; library loaded from an Ubuntu 24.04 container Python 3.12.3 venv
